cmd: bin/rails runner 'puts "Anchor SQLite: #{ActiveRecord::Base.connection_db_config.database}"; puts Document.column_names.join(", "); puts DocumentChunk.column_names.join(", ")'

bin/rails runner 'db = ActiveRecord::Base.connection_db_config.database.to_s; system("sqlite3", "-header", "-column", db, "SELECT d.tenant_id,d.id AS document_id,d.status,p.id AS parent_id,l.id AS leaf_id,l.text,l.window_text,l.embedding_dimensions FROM documents d JOIN document_chunks l ON l.document_id=d.id AND l.is_leaf=1 JOIN document_chunks p ON p.id=l.parent_id WHERE d.tenant_id IN (101,202) ORDER BY d.tenant_id,l.chunk_index;") || abort("sqlite3 failed")'

bin/rails runner 'db = ActiveRecord::Base.connection_db_config.database.to_s; system("sqlite3", db, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM document_chunks c LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.id=c.document_id LEFT JOIN document_chunks p ON p.id=c.parent_id WHERE d.id IS NULL OR c.tenant_id<>d.tenant_id OR (c.is_leaf=0 AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL) OR (c.is_leaf=1 AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.is_leaf<>0 OR p.document_id<>c.document_id OR p.tenant_id<>c.tenant_id));") || abort("sqlite3 failed")'

bin/rails runner 'db = ActiveRecord::Base.connection_db_config.database.to_s; system("sqlite3", "-header", "-column", db, "SELECT tenant_id,content_hash,COUNT(*) AS copies FROM documents WHERE tenant_id IN (101,202) GROUP BY tenant_id,content_hash; SELECT document_id,chunk_index,COUNT(*) AS copies FROM document_chunks GROUP BY document_id,chunk_index HAVING COUNT(*)>1;") || abort("sqlite3 failed")'
